o.text:
From Proto-Common Turkic *badram, probably from Iranian (see the reconstruction page for more).
Compare Karakhanid بَذْرَمْ (baḏram), Sogdian [script needed] (ptrʾm /⁠patrăm⁠/, “calm, peace”), Persian پدرام (pedrâm, “lucky, happy”).
From Arabic عَسْكَرِيّ (ʕaskariyy, “soldier”) or Arabic عَسْكَر (ʕaskar, “army”). See it for more.
